description: "Letters on International Copyright; Second Edition" by Henry Charles Carey is a critical examination of copyright laws and their implications, written in the late 19th century. The book addresses the contentious debate between authors and the public regarding the ownership of literary works and the rights of international authors, particularly focusing on the proposed treaties concerning copyright.
